usedFor: Each “New Tag Created” in Asana copies a template file into a Google Drive folder.

bestTemplate.name: “New Tag Created” in Asana, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: A new tag marks a new client or topic, so work starts from a ready template.

watchOut: “New Tag Created” polls on a schedule, so the copy can appear a little after the tag.
